title: AI Ready Practical Architecture Catalog
scope: General-purpose AI architecture and practical use. No industry platform is required.

mcp.note: The 2026-07-28 revision uses a stateless protocol core and an extensions model. Check the official specification before implementation because MCP is evolving quickly.

tracks.title: System Boundaries
tracks.goal: Separate model decisions from deterministic application logic, data, state, authorization, and side effects.

tracks.title: Data and RAG
tracks.goal: Use current or private evidence with source ownership, permissions, retrieval tests, and provenance.

tracks.title: Tools and MCP
tracks.goal: Connect models to external systems through narrow contracts and use MCP where shared capability reuse creates value.

tracks.title: Agent Architecture
tracks.goal: Use adaptive loops only when changing evidence makes a fixed workflow insufficient.

tracks.title: Evals and Reliability
tracks.goal: Turn model, retrieval, tool, agent, safety, latency, and cost quality into regression tests.

tracks.title: Security and Governance
tracks.goal: Treat external content as untrusted data and keep permissions, secrets, approvals, and policy outside model control.

tracks.title: Build and Operate
tracks.goal: Move from a demo to a versioned, observable, budgeted, recoverable service.

decision_matrix.need: Rewrite, classify, extract, or transform text
decision_matrix.rule: Start with instructions, examples, and a schema. Do not add RAG or an agent without an external-data or workflow need.
Use retrieval before fine-tuning. Keep source IDs, permissions, validity metadata, and citations.

decision_matrix.need: Exact current fact from an external system
decision_matrix.rule: Use a typed read tool instead of asking the model to remember or infer the fact.

decision_matrix.need: Deterministic action in an external system
decision_matrix.rule: Use a typed tool contract. Validate input, output, authorization, and preconditions outside the model.
Use MCP when shared discovery, contracts, governance, or portability create real reuse.
Start deterministic. Add model decisions only at uncertain steps.

decision_matrix.need: Known set of workflows but messy input
decision_matrix.rule: Use one model decision to route to a known path, with a fallback for uncertain routing.
Use a read-first agent loop with budgets, explicit stop states, tracing, and escalation.
Separate investigation, prepared change, validation, approval, and idempotent execution.

decision_matrix.need: Persistent behavior gap after simpler controls
decision_matrix.rule: Fine-tune only after evals show a stable gap not solved well by prompt, schema, retrieval, or tools.

production_rules: Separate model reasoning from authorization decisions.
Use deterministic calculation or validation when code can express the rule.
Read-only tools are the default; write tools need narrower scopes and stronger controls.
Never treat retrieved or tool-returned text as trusted instructions.
Make write operations idempotent where possible and use request IDs or stable business keys.
Bind approval to the exact prepared action, target, precondition, approver, and expiry.
Trace model, prompt, retrieval, tool, authorization, evidence, latency, and stop reason without leaking secrets.
Test timeouts, partial results, duplicate requests, stale data, denied permission, malformed output, injection, and budget exhaustion.
Version prompts, tool schemas, retrieval configuration, datasets, evals, and policy with the application.
Plan degraded behavior and rollback for model, prompt, retrieval, tool server, and policy changes.

hands_on_labs.title: Read-only MCP Workspace
hands_on_labs.build: Expose synthetic projects, tasks, and notes through narrow read tools and resources.

hands_on_labs.title: RAG with Evals
hands_on_labs.build: Index a synthetic product/team corpus, answer with citations, compare retrieval methods, and test against a golden dataset.

hands_on_labs.title: Agent with Approval
hands_on_labs.build: Create a generic operations assistant that investigates with read tools and executes a prepared change only after approval.

hands_on_labs.title: Production Readiness
hands_on_labs.build: Add version metadata, traces, eval gates, failure policy, secrets, budgets, degraded modes, and rollback.

data_artifacts.purpose: Reusable architecture patterns with use conditions, controls, failure modes, and links.
General-purpose architecture decision and failure-path cases for regression testing and learning.
